user.title: Connect to Moonlight
user.description: Enter where the Moonlight add-on (or server) is running. Inside Home Assistant OS the add-on is usually reachable as `{addon_host}` (installed from a local add-on folder) or via your Home Assistant host's IP address, on port {port}.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of Moonlight, e.g. local-moonlight or 192.168.1.20.
Hostname or IP address of Moonlight.

pair.title: Pair Home Assistant with Moonlight

reauth_confirm.title: Pair Home Assistant with Moonlight again
reauth_confirm.description: Moonlight at `{host}` no longer accepts Home Assistant (pairing was turned on, or Home Assistant was revoked under Settings > Screens). Select **Submit** to get a new pairing code.

hassio_confirm.title: Moonlight add-on
hassio_confirm.description: Connect Home Assistant to the {addon} add-on? No pairing code is needed: the add-on made a connection for Home Assistant, listed in Moonlight under Settings > Screens > Connections.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't connect. Check the host and port, and that the add-on is running.
error.not_moonlight: Something answered, but it doesn't look like Moonlight.
error.not_paired: That code hasn't been entered in Moonlight yet. Enter it under Settings > Screens > Pair, then select Submit again.
error.pair_expired: The code expired; here is a new one.
error.pair_busy: Too many screens are waiting to pair with Moonlight. Try again in a few minutes.
error.pair_failed: Moonlight couldn't start pairing. Make sure the add-on is up to date.
error.discovery_rejected: Moonlight didn't accept the add-on's connection (it may have been removed in Moonlight). Restart the Moonlight add-on to get a new one, or add the integration by hand.

abort.already_configured: This Moonlight is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Home Assistant is paired with Moonlight again.
abort.not_moonlight: The Moonlight add-on sent incomplete connection details.

add_chore.name: Add chore
add_chore.description: Adds a one-off chore for a day in Moonlight (for example from an automation when the dishwasher finishes). If the same chore is already waiting for that person on that day, nothing is added.

person.name: Person
person.description: Who does it: a name or person id, or several.

time_of_day.name: Time of day
time_of_day.description: Which part of the day it shows under.

config_entry_id.name: Moonlight
config_entry_id.description: Which Moonlight to use, if you have more than one.

complete_chore.name: Complete chore
complete_chore.description: Ticks off a chore in Moonlight and awards its stars.

person.name: Person
person.description: Name or id of the person the chore belongs to.

date.name: Date
date.description: Day to tick off. Defaults to today.

config_entry_id.name: Moonlight
config_entry_id.description: Which Moonlight to use, if you have more than one.

award_stars.name: Award stars
award_stars.description: Adds (or with a negative number, removes) stars for a person.

person.name: Person
person.description: Name or id of the person.

stars.name: Stars
stars.description: Number of stars; negative to take some away.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Shown in the person's star history.

pin.name: Parent PIN
pin.description: Moonlight's parent PIN, if one is set.

config_entry_id.name: Moonlight
config_entry_id.description: Which Moonlight to use, if you have more than one.

add_list_item.name: Add list item
add_list_item.description: Adds an item to a Moonlight list.

config_entry_id.name: Moonlight
config_entry_id.description: Which Moonlight to use, if you have more than one.

show_notification.name: Show notification
show_notification.description: Shows a notification on Moonlight's screens, full screen or as a toast, for a while or until it is dismissed on a screen or cleared from Home Assistant.

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: Where to show it: all (the default), screen names as in Moonlight's Settings › Screens, or a style: large, compact, phone, or app (the iPhone and iPad apps).

style.name: Style
style.description: Full screen, or a toast in the corner.

full_screen_for.name: Full screen for
full_screen_for.description: Shrink it to a card in the corner after this long (and makes it full screen if Style is left out). Left out: full screen until it goes.

duration.name: Show for
duration.description: How long it stays up. Left out: a toast goes after 10 seconds and a full screen one stays. 0 stays until dismissed or cleared.

image.name: Image
image.description: A picture to show with it: a web address the screens can open.

dismissible.name: Can be dismissed
dismissible.description: Whether a tap on the screen can close it. Off: only Home Assistant can clear it.

chime.name: Chime
chime.description: Play a chime when it appears.

id.name: ID
id.description: Your own name for it, to replace it or clear it later. Left out, Moonlight makes one (returned in the response).

config_entry_id.name: Moonlight
config_entry_id.description: Which Moonlight to use, if you have more than one.

start_timer.name: Start timer
start_timer.description: Shows a timer or a countdown on Moonlight's screens. When it gets to zero it says time's up (and fires a moonlight_alert event). Or it counts up from a moment, like how long since the kettle boiled.

description.name: Description
description.description: A line of detail under the label.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the timer runs. Give this or Until. Counting up: how long after it started it goes (left out: until dismissed or cleared).

until.name: Until
until.description: Count down to this date and time instead.

count_up.name: Count up
count_up.description: Count up from now (or from Since) instead of down, like a stopwatch.

since.name: Since
since.description: Count up from this date and time (a moment already gone). Giving it means count up.

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: Where to show it: all (the default), screen names as in Moonlight's Settings › Screens, or a style: large, compact, phone, or app (the iPhone and iPad apps).

style.name: Style
style.description: Full screen, or a toast in the corner.

full_screen_for.name: Full screen for
full_screen_for.description: Shrink it to a card in the corner after this long (and makes it full screen if Style is left out). Left out: full screen until it goes.

finished_for.name: Keep time's up for
finished_for.description: How long time's up stays once it gets to zero. Left out or 0: until dismissed or cleared.

dismissible.name: Can be dismissed
dismissible.description: Whether a tap on the screen can close it. Off: only Home Assistant can clear it.

chime.name: Chime
chime.description: Play a chime when it gets to zero (on by default), or for one counting up when it appears (off by default).

id.name: ID
id.description: Your own name for it, to replace it or clear it later. Left out, Moonlight makes one (returned in the response).

config_entry_id.name: Moonlight
config_entry_id.description: Which Moonlight to use, if you have more than one.

clear_notifications.name: Clear notifications
clear_notifications.description: Takes notifications and timers off Moonlight's screens: the ones with these IDs, or everything shown on some screens, or everything.

id.name: ID
id.description: Which ones to clear, by the ID they were given.

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: Without an ID: clear everything shown on these screens (names or styles). Left out: clear everything.

config_entry_id.name: Moonlight
config_entry_id.description: Which Moonlight to use, if you have more than one.
